access: Requires account and a verified active paid subscription. Client previews never confer access.
prerequisite: Complete foundation or pass an equivalent diagnostic, subject to future server-side implementation.

tracks.name: AI for Business
tracks.tagline: Build smarter operations, decisions and customer experiences.
tracks.outcome: A documented AI operating playbook with three measurable workflow improvements.

weeks.practice: Map repetitive tasks, customer bottlenecks and high-value decisions
Research competitors, summarise customer insight and draft support workflows
Create sales, service and operations prompts with human review checkpoints
Run a small pilot, record time saved and define risk controls

tracks.name: AI Automation & Agents
tracks.tagline: Connect tools and automate repeatable work responsibly.
tracks.outcome: A tested, documented multi-step automation with rollback and human approval.

weeks.practice: Define triggers, inputs, outputs, failure conditions and approvals
Use webhooks, structured data and no-code branches
Implement validation, retries, prompt injection resistance and manual review
Measure reliability, costs and errors; document a recovery plan

tracks.name: AI Content & Marketing
tracks.tagline: Create compelling campaigns with consistent brand voice.
tracks.outcome: A cohesive, original campaign with copy, visuals, measurement and disclosure notes.

weeks.practice: Define positioning, channel choices and a responsible content brief
Develop editorial copy, social templates and accessible visual concepts
Create landing-page concepts, A/B tests and review workflows
Analyse campaign results and revise the narrative

tracks.name: AI for Work & Careers
tracks.tagline: Use AI to improve applications, communication and everyday output.
tracks.audience: Job seekers, students and working professionals
tracks.outcome: An evidence-based career portfolio with an interview practice plan.

weeks.practice: Identify career goals, skills gaps and ethical AI use
Improve role-specific resumes and truthful achievement stories
Plan meetings, research and write with source verification
Run structured mock interviews and define a personal development plan

tracks.name: AI Entrepreneurship
tracks.tagline: Validate a real customer problem before investing in a venture.
tracks.outcome: A grounded venture brief, customer validation evidence and pilot plan.

weeks.practice: Interview potential customers and distinguish pain from interest
Compare alternatives, estimate costs and define pricing assumptions
Create a simple offer, landing page and human-reviewed sales copy
Collect feedback, measure outcomes and decide to iterate or stop
